checkpoints.description: [1/3] Design quantitative meta-analysis engine and forest plot generator (lattice/meta.py)

impact_assessment.why: Enable researchers and agents to execute quantitative meta-analyses with inverse-variance fixed and DerSimonian-Laird random effects, Cochran's Q, I-squared, and vector SVG/ASCII forest plots
impact_assessment.benefits: Completes the systematic review pipeline from PRISMA screening to statistical pooling and publication-quality forest plot visualization without third-party dependencies
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new meta-analysis module and MCP tool; dependency: none, standard library math only; concurrency: thread-safe pure functional computations; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Statistical verification against standard analytical cases, 100% unit test coverage, ADR-030
